Microsoft.title: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing diseases
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing diseases
Microsoft.titleKo: 마이크로소프트는 자사의 AI 도구가 질병 진단에 있어 의사보다 낫다고 밝힘
Microsoft.summary:
The company claims to have developed an AI-powered tool it says can diagnose conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
The AI system also tended to reach its diagnoses at a lower estimated cost than human counterparts.
On cases taken from hundreds of reports published in The New England Journal of Medicine , Microsoft’s system achieved a diagnostic accuracy of around 83 percent, compared with roughly 36 percent for generalist physicians using references and 22 percent for those working without them.

summaryLinesKo: 이 회사는 인간 의사보다 최대 4배 더 정확하게 상태를 진단할 수 있는 AI 기반 도구를 개발했다고 주장함
AI 시스템은 또한 인간보다 낮은 추정 비용으로 진단에 도달하는 경향이 있었음
The New England Journal of Medicine에 게재된 수백 건의 보고서에서 얻은 사례에서 Microsoft 시스템은 약 83%의 진단 정확도를 달성한 반면, 참고 문헌을 사용하는 일반 의사의 경우 약 36%, 참고 문헌 없이 작업하는 경우 22%를 기록함

Microsoft.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
Microsoft.titleKo: 마이크로소프트의 무스타파 술레이만(Mustafa Suleyman)은 '의학적 초지능'을 추구하면서 자사의 AI가 어려운 사건에서 의사보다 뛰어난 성능을 발휘한다고 말함
Microsoft.summary:
Microsoft’s study in Science coincides with a manifesto of sorts around what it will take to build medical superintelligence, defined as “the capacity to surpass the strongest contemporary human-led health systems in medical reasoning and coordination across the full arc of care.”
The following year, Google DeepMind acquired King’s startup Hark, a clinical task management app, and the two of them launched DeepMind Health together.
On complex cases, DxO increased GPT-5.5’s accuracy score from 72% to nearly 87% at a slightly cheaper cost.

summaryLinesKo: 마이크로소프트의 과학 연구는 "치료 전반에 걸쳐 의학적 추론과 조정에서 가장 강력한 현대 인간 주도 의료 시스템을 능가하는 능력"으로 정의되는 의료 초지능을 구축하는 데 필요한 것에 대한 일종의 선언문과 일치함
이듬해 Google DeepMind는 King의 스타트업인 임상 작업 관리 앱인 Hark를 인수했고, 두 사람은 DeepMind Health를 함께 출시함
복잡한 사례에서 DxO는 약간 저렴한 비용으로 GPT-5.5의 정확도 점수를 72%에서 거의 87%로 높였음

Microsoft.title: GitHub - nano-muse/nanoMuse: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.

Microsoft.summary:
MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.
One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Open an issue or send a pull request ; either one helps nanoMuse get better. 2026-10-13 ⭐ 1,000 stars on GitHub, eighteen days after the first release, with four days on GitHub Trending's Swift list on the way ( Trendshift : seventh on October 7, fourth on October 10).

Microsoft.summary:
Last year, we introduced Microsoft Sovereign Cloud to give customers more choice in how they address these requirements.
Oct 20, 2026 | Douglas Phillips - President and Chief Technology Officer, Microsoft Specialized Clouds Across my conversations with leaders in government, critical infrastructure and regulated industries, one priority consistently rises to the top: putting technology to work on their most important systems while maintaining the control those systems require.
Digital sovereignty should give organizations greater control and security over the technology they depend on, while continuing to innovate.

NVIDIA.summary:
Labeling one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 is what Nvidia promises with Flora, its open data engine.
Claude Opus 5 scored much worse in the same test and still cost about $42 per hour.
In a test with 50 videos, Flora scored slightly better than GPT-6 Astra according to Nvidia, even though OpenAI's model was allowed to use its full reasoning capacity.

NVIDIA.summary:
The company aims to have more than 3,500 robotaxis operating in over 20 cities worldwide by the end of 2026, up from a fleet of 1,975 vehicles at the end of June.
It has also introduced rules for autonomous vehicles to be tested on certain public roads.
Nvidia says its Hyperion platform could lower the cost of developing robotaxis by giving companies a ready-made foundation of sensors and computing technology, rather than requiring them to build and integrate everything themselves.

NVIDIA.title: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
NVIDIA.titleEn: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future
NVIDIA.titleKo: 카자흐스탄, AI 미래를 위해 컴퓨팅 확장
NVIDIA.summary:
“What began as a seed of an idea 180 days ago has grown into a major investment in Kazakhstan’s AI future,” said Razmig Hovaghimian, co-Founder and CEO of Firebird.

That includes Nemotron-Personas-Germany, an open dataset of 1 million records, each with six synthetic personas, grounded in the 2022 census across all 16 federal states and 400 districts.
The planned offering combines four components: NVIDIA accelerated computing and NVIDIA Nemotron open models; Red Hat OpenShift AI for deploying and managing AI workloads; deepset’s Haystack AI agent orchestration; and infrastructure operated by secunet in German data centers.
To support local development, the Sovereign Open Source Foundation Models research initiative (Soofi) is developing a family of AI models for German industry and the public sector.

NVIDIA.title: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction
NVIDIA.titleEn: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction
NVIDIA.titleKo: 유럽 전역의 개척자들이 NVIDIA Earth-2 개방형 모델을 배포하여 실제 날씨 및 기후 예측을 지원함
NVIDIA.summary:
A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally.
Organizations building on Earth-2 capabilities include: AXA is using NVIDIA Earth-2’s FourCastNet 3 to study regional cyclone risk beyond the historical record across more than 1,000 simulated seasons, generating insights that can inform risk assessments and help customers target prevention efforts.
Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA는 디지털 검색에서 물리적 운영으로 유럽 소매를 혁신함
NVIDIA.summary:
Omi runs TRELLIS 3D asset generation on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, speeding up inference by 10x and reducing pipeline latency by 4x.
Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D.
Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
NVIDIA.titleKo: NVIDIA Cosmos, 월드 모델을 훈련, 평가 및 배포하기 위한 새로운 도구 공개
NVIDIA.summary:
To develop a world model specialized for egocentric manipulation, robotics research lab MicroAGI post-trained Cosmos 3 on videos of humans manipulating objects and distilled its 32-billion-parameter reasoner down to an 8-billion-parameter Nano model with no loss in accuracy.
Developers can deploy core Cosmos models using updated NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM microservices, which deliver up to 2x faster inference with no quality loss in validated configurations, while continuous video analysis enables sub-second alerts.
To help developers rapidly build world models , which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints.

개발자는 업데이트된 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 NIM 마이크로서비스를 사용하여 핵심 Cosmos 모델을 배포할 수 있음 · 이는 검증된 구성에서 품질 손실 없이 최대 2배 더 빠른 추론을 제공하는 동시에 지속적인 비디오 분석을 통해 1초 미만의 경고가 가능함
개발자가 실제 AI 시스템이 실제 세계를 이해하고 시뮬레이션하는 데 도움이 되는 세계 모델을 신속하게 구축할 수 있도록 NVIDIA는 새로운 교육 도구, 시뮬레이션 체크포인트 및 Cosmos Data Factory 청사진을 통해 Cosmos 플랫폼을 확장함

Chinese through the iOS pinyin keyboard) Faster steps: several actions per model call, pointer checks only when needed A curated list of models that work best with this setup, shown inside the iOS app ( suggested by @asharthinks ) BLE carries about 300-500 kbps, so the screen is mirrored small (480×1040, ≤5 fps); each step takes a few seconds, most of it the model.

Apple.title: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
Apple.titleEn: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
Apple.summary:
Last November, we introduced AnyLanguageModel on this blog: a drop-in replacement for Apple's Foundation Models framework that lets you choose the model and provider your app uses.
Support for hosted models expanded this year, too.
A year and dozens of releases later, AnyLanguageModel 1.0 is out, along with swift-huggingface 1.0 and swift-xet 1.0 .

Apple.summary:
The Surface Laptop Ultra is around 25 percent faster than the Dell XPS 14 at generating text in these lighter models, which only range from 3.5-billion parameters up to 12-billion.
The system can support up to three 4K external monitors or a single 5K display.
You can buy the RTX 5070 model of the Blade 16 with 32 GB of RAM and a terabyte of storage for $2,999—a similar configuration and price to the Surface Laptop Ultra.

Google DeepMind.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google의 AI 검색 변경으로 온라인 출판이 뒤바뀌었음
Google DeepMind.summary:
Between May and June 2025, DCN says 19 of its members experienced a traffic loss on Google, ranging from 1 to 25 percent, Digiday reported.
In May 2025, it launched AI Mode , a feature that replaces Google’s standard search engine with a chatbot-like interface that provides detailed summaries from results on the web.
DMG Media, which owns Daily Mail and Metro , told the UK’s Competition and Markets Authority that click-through rates dropped by up to 89 percent between June and July 2025, citing impacts from AI Overviews.

Google DeepMind.summary:
Gemini 4 Argon , our new frontier model, excels at tackling complex projects.
Since we rolled out Argon broadly last week, we've seen builders tap into its expanded abilities to create interactive tools, engineer 3D worlds, and more.
Argon excels at deep work in complex, real-world tasks to help across domains including coding, finance, legal, cybersecurity, and science.

Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google의 Agent Compute Engine은 모든 Gemini 에이전트에 하드웨어로 분리된 자체 마이크로 가상 머신을 제공함
Google DeepMind.summary:
When an agent idles, its VM pauses automatically and frees up the machine for others.
VMs are a pretty huge cost factor when providing agentic systems, so Google is going after efficiency here.
Google announced Agent Compute Engine, a service that gives each AI agent its own isolated virtual machine.

Google DeepMind.title: Not All Forests Are Equal: Mapping the World’s Forests
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Not All Forests Are Equal: Mapping the World’s Forests
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 모든 숲이 같지는 않음 · 세계 숲 지도 작성
Google DeepMind.summary:
To teach our model the difference, we built a large-scale collection of forest-type examples with about 1.7 million labeled locations drawn from expert surveys, national and regional datasets, and targeted reviews of places where the model struggled.
We hope governments, companies, conservation groups and scientists will use them to help build deforestation-free supply chains, direct forest finance where it’s needed, and protect the natural forests that matter most.
Today, Google DeepMind and Google Research, together with the World Resources Institute (WRI) and the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), are releasing Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020 , a global map that categorizes every 10-by-10-meter patch of land on Earth into six distinct forest and land-use types, a key baseline for the EU's deforestation regulation.

summaryLinesKo: 모델의 차이점을 가르치기 위해 전문가 설문 조사, 국가 및 지역 데이터 세트, 모델이 어려움을 겪는 장소에 대한 대상 검토를 통해 얻은 약 170만 개의 라벨이 지정된 위치를 포함하는 대규모 숲 유형 사례 컬렉션을 구축함
우리는 정부, 기업, 환경 보호 단체 및 과학자들이 이를 사용하여 삼림 벌채 없는 공급망을 구축하고, 필요한 곳에 산림 금융을 직접 제공하고, 가장 중요한 자연림을 보호하는 데 도움을 주기를 바람
오늘 Google DeepMind 및 Google Research는 WRI(세계 자원 연구소) 및 IIASA(국제 응용 시스템 분석 연구소)와 함께 지구상의 모든 10x10미터 토지를 6가지 산림 및 토지 이용 유형으로 분류하는 글로벌 지도인 산림 유형학(ForTy) 2020을 출시함 · 이는 EU 삼림 벌채 규제의 핵심 기준임

Google DeepMind.titleEn: Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 | Google Cloud Blog
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 핵심 PHP 취약점 CVE-2026-109618 및 CVE-2026-109619에 대한 대응 | Google 클라우드 블로그
Google DeepMind.summary:
Vulnerable versions : All versions of PHP from 5.4 through 8.5.11 Not patched : The PHP project is not releasing fixes for PHP 8.1 or earlier, which have reached end of life .
At Google Cloud, we understand the severity of these vulnerabilities, and are sharing guidance to help our customers take immediate action to secure their applications.
21, 2026, CVE.org assigned the vulnerabilities as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

Google DeepMind.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
Google DeepMind.titleEn: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
Google DeepMind.titleKo: OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Sol과 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon에서 수백만 개의 웹사이트에 영향을 미치는 심각한 PHP 결함을 발견함
Google DeepMind.summary:
GPT-5.6 Sol tracked down the flaw as part of the Patch-the-Planet initiative , which OpenAI calls one of the "most impactful security issues in recent memory."
The company expects findings on the scale of the PHP2Shell flaw to "increase sharply in the coming months," but warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
Security firm Wiz found the same flaws independently, using its own Wiz Atlas platform alongside Google's Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.

summaryLinesKo: GPT-5.6 Sol은 OpenAI가 "최근 메모리에서 가장 영향력 있는 보안 문제" 중 하나라고 부르는 Patch-the-Planet 이니셔티브의 일환으로 결함을 추적함
회사는 PHP2Shell 결함 규모에 대한 발견이 "앞으로 몇 달 안에 급격히 증가"할 것으로 예상하지만, 취약점을 찾는 동일한 AI 기능이 공격자에게도 도움이 될 수 있다고 경고함
보안 회사인 Wiz는 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon 및 GPT-5.6 Sol과 함께 자체 Wiz Atlas 플랫폼을 사용하여 동일한 결함을 독립적으로 발견함

Amazon.titleEn: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.summary:
SageMaker AI requires you to deregister the scalable target before updating the endpoint, but when you deregister it, CloudFormation can’t track the AWS Application Auto Scaling resources.
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-sagemaker-endpoint-autoscaling.git cd sample-sagemaker-endpoint-autoscaling The endpoint and auto scaling settings are defined together in config/ config.yaml because a single config_hash drives the auto scaling orchestration.
When you deploy a SageMaker AI endpoint with native CloudFormation auto scaling resources, then change the endpoint configuration and redeploy, several failure modes emerge.

Amazon.summary:
As Rescale’s platform grew, so did the operational overhead of keeping it running.
First, the team planned to host the agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, then moved it to Amazon EKS, where Rescale already runs its Argo Workflows CI/CD pipeline.
Hundreds of test cases run in the suite, and when failures appeared, every alert, bug report, and escalation needed to be classified, prioritized, and routed to the right team.

Amazon.titleEn: Stop guessing auto scaling targets for TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services

Amazon.summary:
The deployed policy scales on ConcurrentRequestsPerModel , a native metric Amazon SageMaker AI publishes itself rather than one this project’s own container code has to emit.
The live command freezes auto scaling and pins capacity to one instance for the duration, restored automatically on exit, so the number it produces is a genuine per-instance ceiling.
A stopped or canceled qmax or ttotal run is the most common source of a reported mismatch, because it can leave auto scaling frozen on a single instance. uv run tts-bench thaw --endpoint speech-kokoro-82m restores the deployed policy before you proceed, since qmax and ttotal both assume the deployed state matches the config file exactly.

Kokoro-82M holds only 82 million parameters, small enough to run cheaply on a single mid-tier GPU instance.

Anthropic.summary:

Anthropic.title: Reverse engineering Claude's CVE-2026-2796 exploit
Anthropic.summary:
We’re sharing this case study to provide an early glimpse into what we expect will be LLMs’ improving ability to author exploits.
The result is an argument-shifting wrapper: Firefox has a fast path for this case (that is, a special codepath in the interpreter that makes this function run more efficiently), and that fast path is where our vulnerability lives.
Specifically, Claude needed to exploit a stripped-down version of the js shell (a standalone utility that lets developers use Firefox’s JavaScript engine without the browser) that resembles an unsandboxed content process in the browser, and a task verifier to determine whether the exploit worked.

결과는 인수 이동 래퍼임 · Firefox는 이 경우에 대한 빠른 경로(즉, 이 기능을 보다 효율적으로 실행하는 인터프리터의 특수 코드 경로)를 갖고 있으며, 그 빠른 경로가 취약점이 존재하는 곳임
특히 Claude는 브라우저에서 샌드박스 처리되지 않은 콘텐츠 프로세스와 유사한 js 셸(개발자가 브라우저 없이 Firefox의 JavaScript 엔진을 사용할 수 있도록 하는 독립 실행형 유틸리티)의 간단한 버전과 공격이 작동하는지 확인하기 위한 작업 검증기를 활용해야 함

Anthropic.title: AI models on realistic cyber ranges
Anthropic.titleEn: AI models on realistic cyber ranges
Anthropic.summary:
Sonnet 4.5 accomplishes this by instantly recognizing a publicized CVE and writing code to exploit it without needing to look it up or iterate on it.
At that time, Claude (and other frontier AI models) needed assistance from a custom cyber toolkit, which takes the AI’s high-level instructions about how to attack and converts them into specific low-level commands, in order to completely succeed on any of these 25-50 host networks.
This illustrates how barriers to the use of AI in relatively autonomous cyber workflows are rapidly coming down, and highlights the importance of security fundamentals like promptly patching known vulnerabilities.

OpenAI.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
OpenAI.titleEn: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
OpenAI.titleKo: 선택을 강요받은 Grok의 AI 모델은 공화당원을 선택함 · OpenAI가 민주당을 선택함
OpenAI.summary:
A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.
Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.
summaryLinesEn: A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.

Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.
summaryLinesKo: 새로운 연구에 따르면 올해 중간 선거에서 선택을 강요당했을 때 SpaceXAI의 Grok 4.7은 답변의 92%에서 공화당 후보를 추천한 반면 OpenAI의 GPT-6.1 Sol은 97%에서 민주당 후보를 선택함
머스크는 중간선거에서 공화당 후보를 지원하기 위해 4억 4500만 달러 이상을 기부했는데, 이는 2024년 선거에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 당을 지원하기 위해 지출한 약 25억 달러를 넘어선 것임
GPT의 민주당 성향은 검색 없이 나타남 · 후보자 이름을 말하면 30개 경선 중 24개 경선에서 민주당을 선택하고 공화당 경선 1개를 선택하고 나머지 5개 경선을 거부함

OpenAI.summary:
More fixes went to other projects, and OpenAI reported additional, as-yet-unpublished vulnerabilities through the "Patch the Planet" initiative.
On September 20, an internal research model exploited a misconfigured DNS resolver to reach the open internet during training, even though OpenAI had already tightened security after the now infamous Hugging Face incident in July and other observed misalignment cases .
Ad Full network isolation, a so-called air gap, isn't feasible yet because experiments still need external connections for operations and monitoring, the company says.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI는 "상당한 위험"을 이유로 더 이상 라이브 인터넷에서 AI 모델을 훈련하지 않을 것이라고 밝힘
OpenAI.summary:
On Friday, OpenAI said that it will train its models using cached copies and simulated versions of the internet instead of the live web because the models are too unpredictable to be trusted with live internet access.
The decision to train these models in sandboxes cut off from the internet is notable because employees at frontier labs have insisted that doing so would be nearly infeasible.
Keeping AI data centers separate from the internet “would need research teams to essentially be embedded inside of data centers in Iowa or wherever else around the world,” former OpenAI researcher Steven Adler told Fortune this month.

인터넷과 단절된 샌드박스에서 이러한 모델을 훈련시키기로 한 결정은 주목할 만함 · 왜냐하면 Frontier Lab의 직원들은 그렇게 하는 것이 거의 불가능할 것이라고 주장했기 때문임

OpenAI.summary:
Optimizing performance for any platform or audience with GPT-4.1, gpt-image-1, and text-to-speech models Creating high-quality videos for marketing, sales, and social media has traditionally required working across complex software with manual timelines, which can be time-intensive for small teams and solo creators.
Today, invideo AI helps over 50 million users create more than 7 million videos each month across ads, explainers, and short-form content.
This level of orchestration means invideo AI can produce not just finished videos, but finished strategies with content that’s tailored to its audience, format, and performance goals.

SpaceX.summary:
And Nolan is, in many ways, a perfect foil for Musk — while SpaceX and Tesla CEO hypes up data centers in space and posts an unending stream of AI-generated content, Nolan has described himself as “a techno-skeptic ” and said that before AI, he’d never seen a technology “so completely rejected by the public.”
Musk had previously lashed out at Christopher Nolan’s version of “The Odyssey” because Nolan cast nonwhite and transgender actors.

SpaceX.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
SpaceX.titleEn: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
SpaceX.titleKo: 선택을 강요받은 Grok의 AI 모델은 공화당원을 선택함 · OpenAI가 민주당을 선택함
SpaceX.summary:
A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.
Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.
summaryLinesEn: A new study found that when forced to choose in this year’s upcoming midterm elections, SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of its answers, while OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol picked the Democrat in 97%.

Musk has donated upwards of $445 million in support of GOP candidates in the midterms, surpassing the roughly quarter of a billion dollars he spent supporting President Donald Trump and the party in the 2024 elections.
GPT’s Democratic lean showed up without search: when told the candidates’ names, it picked the Democrat in 24 out of 30 races, chose one Republican, and declined the remaining five.
summaryLinesKo: 새로운 연구에 따르면 올해 중간 선거에서 선택을 강요당했을 때 SpaceXAI의 Grok 4.7은 답변의 92%에서 공화당 후보를 추천한 반면 OpenAI의 GPT-6.1 Sol은 97%에서 민주당 후보를 선택함
머스크는 중간선거에서 공화당 후보를 지원하기 위해 4억 4500만 달러 이상을 기부했는데, 이는 2024년 선거에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 당을 지원하기 위해 지출한 약 25억 달러를 넘어선 것임
GPT의 민주당 성향은 검색 없이 나타남 · 후보자 이름을 말하면 30개 경선 중 24개 경선에서 민주당을 선택하고 공화당 경선 1개를 선택하고 나머지 5개 경선을 거부함

SpaceX.title: SpaceX posts first operating profit as public company as AI revenue nearly triples to $7.6 billion—cruising past Starlink | Fortune
SpaceX.titleEn: SpaceX posts first operating profit as public company as AI revenue nearly triples to $7.6 billion—cruising past Starlink | Fortune
SpaceX.titleKo: SpaceX는 AI 수익이 거의 3배 증가한 76억 달러로 Starlink | 행운
SpaceX.summary:
Elon Musk’s SpaceX said Tuesday that third-quarter revenue rose 161% to $14.6 billion year over year, cruising past the $12.86 billion analysts expected, according to Visible Alpha consensus from S&P Global Market Intelligence.
Connectivity revenue, mostly from Starlink, rose 69% to $5.25 billion, against the $4.92 billion analysts expected, and connectivity operating income nearly doubled to $2.37 billion.
SpaceX’s capital investments are expected to nearly triple from about $70 billion this year to $197.4 billion in the 2028 fiscal year, according to figures cited by Melissa Otto, global head of Visible Alpha research at S&P Global.
summaryLinesEn: Elon Musk’s SpaceX said Tuesday that third-quarter revenue rose 161% to $14.6 billion year over year, cruising past the $12.86 billion analysts expected, according to Visible Alpha consensus from S&P Global Market Intelligence.
Connectivity revenue, mostly from Starlink, rose 69% to $5.25 billion, against the $4.92 billion analysts expected, and connectivity operating income nearly doubled to $2.37 billion.

SpaceX’s capital investments are expected to nearly triple from about $70 billion this year to $197.4 billion in the 2028 fiscal year, according to figures cited by Melissa Otto, global head of Visible Alpha research at S&P Global.
summaryLinesKo: S&P 글로벌 마켓 인텔리전스(S&P Global Market Intelligence)의 Visible Alpha 컨센서스에 따르면 엘론 머스크(Elon Musk)의 스페이스X(SpaceX)는 화요일 3분기 매출이 전년 동기 대비 161% 증가한 146억 달러를 기록해 분석가들이 예상한 128억 6천만 달러를 넘어섰다고 밝힘
주로 Starlink에서 나온 연결 수익은 애널리스트 예상 49억 2천만 달러에 비해 69% 증가한 52억 5천만 달러를 기록했으며, 연결 영업 이익은 거의 두 배 증가한 23억 7천만 달러를 기록함
S&P Global의 Visible Alpha 연구 글로벌 책임자인 Melissa Otto가 인용한 수치에 따르면 SpaceX의 자본 투자는 올해 약 700억 달러에서 2028 회계연도에는 1,974억 달러로 거의 3배 증가할 것으로 예상됨

SpaceX.titleEn: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
SpaceX.summary:
SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion, a turnaround from the $1 billion loss in the same quarter last year.
The top-line revenue number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of Bitcoin prices and unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company.
That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially its renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which generated $7.5 billion in revenue from the recently acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute.

Databricks.summary:
Declarative pipelines contain 51% less code for the same pipeline, so there is far less to read and review.
AI agents now write a growing share of production data pipelines ( over 70% of SDP pipelines on Databricks are now created by agents) which raises the stakes in two areas: (1) every attempt an agent makes costs compute and time, so iterations need to be cheap and efficient to run; and (2) code review become a critical gate, so the code needs to be succinct, readable, and correct.
Declarative pipelines offload boilerplate tasks to Spark We benchmarked 528 agent-built data pipelines - declarative authoring proved cheaper, faster and leaner than procedural code.

AI 에이전트는 이제 프로덕션 데이터 파이프라인의 점점 더 많은 부분을 작성합니다(현재 Databricks의 SDP 파이프라인 중 70% 이상이 에이전트에 의해 생성됨) · 이는 두 가지 영역에서 이해관계를 높임 · (1) 에이전트가 시도할 때마다 비용과 시간이 계산되므로 반복을 저렴하고 효율적으로 실행해야 함 · (2) 코드 검토는 중요한 관문이 되므로 코드는 간결하고 읽기 쉽고 정확해야 함

Databricks.summary:
Catherine: You run Databricks' AI products, and you've also been the internal champion for AI adoption.
Unlimited tokens and hard spend caps both fail, and Databricks has moved to visibility plus progressive friction instead.
In this conversation, Catherine Brown talks with Patrick about what happened when Databricks went all in on AI coding agents: how costs initially spiraled with growing usage , what actually brought unit costs down by as much as 90%, and why every engineering organization needs a control layer between its developers and its models.

Databricks.titleEn: The Fraud Analyst AI Coworker: Detecting Telecom Fraud in Real-Time on One Platform | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 사기 분석가 AI 동료 · 단일 플랫폼에서 실시간으로 통신 사기 탐지 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
According to the Communications Fraud Control Association's 2025 survey, telecom fraud losses have climbed to $41.82 billion 1 , and the broader fraud economy is growing fast: U.S. consumers alone reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% jump in a single year 2 .
It’s revenue leakage, regulatory exposure, accelerated churn, and an operations tax that rarely shows up cleanly in a loss report.
Breaches are getting more expensive too; the global average cost of a data breach hit a record $4.88 million in 2024 3 ; Every dollar of fraud costs a carrier roughly 3.4x once you count chargebacks, replacement costs, and the operational overhead of investigating it.

It’s revenue leakage, regulatory exposure, accelerated churn, and an operations tax that rarely shows up cleanly in a loss report.

Breaches are getting more expensive too; the global average cost of a data breach hit a record $4.88 million in 2024 3 ; Every dollar of fraud costs a carrier roughly 3.4x once you count chargebacks, replacement costs, and the operational overhead of investigating it.
summaryLinesKo: 통신 사기 통제 협회(Communications Fraud Control Association)의 2025년 조사에 따르면, 통신 사기 손실은 418억 2천만 달러로 증가했으며1 , 광범위한 사기 경제는 빠르게 성장하고 있음 · 미국 소비자만 해도 2024년에 사기로 인해 125억 달러 이상 손실을 입었다고 보고했는데, 이는 1년 만에 25% 증가한 수치임
수익 누출, 규제 노출, 가속화된 이탈, 손실 보고서에 거의 깔끔하게 표시되지 않는 운영세 등이 있음
위반 비용도 점점 더 커지고 있음 · 2024년에 데이터 유출로 인한 전 세계 평균 비용은 488만 달러를 기록했습니다 3 · 지불 거절, 교체 비용, 조사에 따른 운영 오버헤드를 계산하면 사기 행위로 인한 1달러당 운송업체의 비용은 약 3.4배임

Databricks.title: The new economics of AI cost management | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: The new economics of AI cost management | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: AI 비용 관리의 새로운 경제학 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
A lot of people were reluctant to start using AI, so showing that the leaders everyone looked up to were heavy AI users gave others a reason to follow.
AI observability that once measured success by token volume is starting to measure success by return on investment, and the enterprises that figure out cost management first are the ones that will be able to scale AI without their spend outrunning their revenue.
We sat down with Kevin Stumpf, a Senior Staff Engineer at Databricks and Technical Lead for Unity Gateway, to talk through how teams should actually put that discipline into practice: not treating AI cost as a line item to minimize, but as a system to manage.

We sat down with Kevin Stumpf, a Senior Staff Engineer at Databricks and Technical Lead for Unity Gateway, to talk through how teams should actually put that discipline into practice: not treating AI cost as a line item to minimize, but as a system to manage.

한때 토큰 양으로 성공을 측정했던 AI 관찰 가능성은 투자 수익으로 성공을 측정하기 시작했으며, 비용 관리를 먼저 파악하는 기업은 비용을 지출하지 않고도 수익을 초과하지 않고 AI를 확장할 수 있는 기업임

Databricks.titleEn: Databricks brings GPT-5.5 to enterprise agent workflows
Databricks.titleKo: Databricks는 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 워크플로에 GPT-5.5를 도입함
Databricks.summary:
In the agent-harness setting, GPT‑5.5 reduced errors by 46% compared to GPT‑5.4 and became the first model to surpass 50% accuracy on OfficeQA Pro.
GPT‑5.5 set a new state of the art on OfficeQA Pro, Databricks’ benchmark for complex enterprise agent tasks.
Databricks now makes GPT‑5.5 available through AI Unity Gateway, where customers use the model inside workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API.

Databricks now makes GPT‑5.5 available through AI Unity Gateway, where customers use the model inside workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API.
summaryLinesKo: 에이전트 하네스 설정에서 GPT-5.5는 GPT-5.4에 비해 오류를 46% 줄였으며 OfficeQA Pro에서 정확도 50%를 넘은 최초의 모델이 됨
GPT‑5.5는 복잡한 엔터프라이즈 에이전트 작업에 대한 Databricks의 벤치마크인 OfficeQA Pro에 새로운 최첨단 기술을 설정함

Databricks.summary:
Too often, AI teams spend more time securing GPU capacity, managing failures, and waiting for experiments to launch than improving their models.
Running GPU infrastructure separately from their Lakehouse adds governance gaps and puts sensitive training data at risk.
Today, we’re excited to announce the General Availability of AI Runtime (AIR), bringing fully managed GPU infrastructure directly into Databricks so customers can train their most demanding models where their enterprise data already lives.

Perplexity.summary:
One alternative is Nvidia Corp.’s OpenShell project, which was released last month as part of a broader Open Agent Safety Platform .
With Perplexity’s Computer agents, SPACE provides safety features such as isolated code execution, pause and resume, recovery and session branching.
The company has developed an AI sandbox specifically for isolating AI agents called SPACE , and it’s being made open source from today, which means every developer can use the tool to secure their own systems.

Perplexity의 컴퓨터 에이전트를 통해 SPACE는 격리된 코드 실행, 일시 중지 및 재개, 복구 및 세션 분기와 같은 안전 기능을 제공함

Sierra AI.titleKo: Sierra Summit 2025 소개 · AI 기반 고객 경험의 미래
Sierra AI.summary:
At Sierra Summit, we’ll be celebrating our partners and unveiling new AI products to power every part of the customer experience — from product discovery, recommendations, and sales, to account and subscription management.
We’ve always believed that great customer service is just the beginning, an essential first step to the ultimate destination: AI agents that help businesses acquire, grow, and retain customers.
Bret and I are excited to announce that Sierra Summit — our first ever customer conference — is coming to San Francisco on Wednesday, November 5th, 2025.

Lovable.summary:
Lovable is SOC 2 Type II, and Enterprise workspaces can't create public projects.
Consider this option when your apps need to read or write Microsoft 365, Entra, Azure, or Fabric data, and the app itself can live on Lovable.
The runner also provisions and maintains the Azure Database for PostgreSQL (Flexible Server) for database tables and the Azure Blob Storage your apps need for object storage.

Hugging Face.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
Hugging Face.titleEn: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
Hugging Face.titleKo: LitPivot: 문학 환경 내에서 역동적인 맥락화를 통해 연구 아이디어 개발
Hugging Face.summary:
In our analysis of meeting notes from four completed computer science research projects, we identified 21 literature-initiated pivots across all four projects.
These studies suggest that LitPivot can support both early exploration and the refinement of an existing research direction.
In a study with 17 researchers, domain experts rated research ideas developed with LitPivot as better grounded in the literature than those developed with a text editor and an AI chat tool.

summaryLinesKo: 완료된 4개의 컴퓨터 과학 연구 프로젝트의 회의록을 분석하면서 우리는 4개 프로젝트 전체에서 문헌을 기반으로 한 21개의 중심점을 식별함
이러한 연구는 LitPivot이 초기 탐색과 기존 연구 방향의 개선을 모두 지원할 수 있음을 시사함
17명의 연구원을 대상으로 한 연구에서 도메인 전문가는 LitPivot을 사용하여 개발한 연구 아이디어가 텍스트 편집기 및 AI 채팅 도구를 사용하여 개발한 아이디어보다 문헌에 더 잘 기반을 두고 있다고 평가함

Hugging Face.titleEn: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
Hugging Face.titleKo: OlmoEarth v1.3: 지구 전체를 위한 최첨단 임베딩
Hugging Face.summary:
Compare each pixel's vector across years, no model training required, and the 2017 to 2020 pair lights up where the mining was spreading to the southeast.
If you wanted to reproduce it, pre-training OlmoEarth v1.3 Base would cost roughly $2,720 of rented H100 time for the final run.
Alongside OlmoEarth v1.3, we’re sharing precomputed, annual embeddings for the whole planet (10m, 64- and 128-dimensions), plus a new browser-based tool to explore and customize maps based on those embeddings — the OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer .

Hugging Face.title: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
Hugging Face.titleEn: Hugging Face’s New AI Biology Model Lets You Chat With DNA
Hugging Face.titleKo: Hugging Face의 새로운 AI 생물학 모델로 DNA와 대화 가능
Hugging Face.summary:
Researchers face restrictions when it comes to uploading identifiable or sensitive patient data to frontier AI models, so Tunstall says his team intentionally designed a small model with 14 billion parameters.
The team started with an existing language model and expanded its vocabulary to read DNA in groups of six letters.
Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.
summaryLinesEn: Researchers face restrictions when it comes to uploading identifiable or sensitive patient data to frontier AI models, so Tunstall says his team intentionally designed a small model with 14 billion parameters.
The team started with an existing language model and expanded its vocabulary to read DNA in groups of six letters.

Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.
summaryLinesKo: 연구자들은 식별 가능하거나 민감한 환자 데이터를 최첨단 AI 모델에 업로드하는 데 제한이 있기 때문에 Tunstall은 그의 팀이 의도적으로 140억 개의 매개변수를 가진 작은 모델을 설계했다고 말함

sourceLines: Researchers face restrictions when it comes to uploading identifiable or sensitive patient data to frontier AI models, so Tunstall says his team intentionally designed a small model with 14 billion parameters.
The team started with an existing language model and expanded its vocabulary to read DNA in groups of six letters.

Lewis Tunstall, a senior research scientist at Hugging Face, says the tool is meant to help researchers design new drugs and genetic therapies, and it could potentially aid patients in interpreting their own genomes.

Hugging Face.summary:
Granite Speech 5.0 2B: more accurate, more robust, more control Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC: now multilingual, more robust, and even faster Granite Speech 4.1 2B Plus: better at who said what, and when We're excited to share three updates to IBM's Granite Speech collection: a new speech-language model, granite-speech-5.0-2b , and revised versions of two models the community already uses, granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc and granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus .
Timestamps: Average timestamp shift (AAS) is cut by more than half, yielding tighter timing in captions, search, and review.
The updated granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus is tuned for the recordings enterprises actually have: meetings, support calls, and interviews with several speakers running long.

Hugging Face.summary:
The files share a numeric hash that identifies them as a pair.
TorchNeuron supports standard PyTorch workflows on Trainium, including eager execution, torch.compile , and standard PyTorch APIs, with minimal code changes.
Additionally, TorchNeuron integrates with Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) to enable custom operators and performance optimization for Trainium hardware.

Abridge.title: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleEn: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleKo: Maine Health 임상의가 진료에 Abridge Assistant를 사용하는 방법
Abridge.summary:
Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

Abridge.titleEn: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare
Abridge.summary:
Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

Writer.summary:
Only 5% of organizations have reached super-user status with 5X productivity gains; the remaining 95% have deployed AI but haven’t achieved compounding returns.
How buyers discover and learn about brands and products has fundamentally shifted, and most marketing teams haven’t caught up.
The Total Economic Impact™ study commissioned by Forrester Consulting on behalf of WRITER found that the composite organization achieved a 333% ROI with a payback period of under 6 months.

DeepSeek.titleEn: DeepSeek 10B Yuan Financing Nears Completion: Partners with Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals, Doubles Raised Funds to Bet Big on Embodied Intelligence
DeepSeek.titleKo: DeepSeek 100억 위안 파이낸싱 완료 임박 · Perfect World, SMIC PES Capital & Industrial Capitals와 제휴, 구현된 지능에 크게 투자하기 위해 자금 조달 두 배 증가
DeepSeek.summary:
If the 100-billion-yuan scale of this round is added to the RMB 51 billion first-round financing finalized by Liang Wenfeng and core institutions at the end of June, DeepSeek has cumulatively absorbed more than RMB 1500 billion of capital in just over 100 days, setting a brand new record for capital throughput speed in the global artificial intelligence field .
In August this year, DeepSeek once launched a high-paying recruitment in the fields of game development and 3D rendering , which attracted widespread attention in the game industry.
Sources familiar with the matter revealed that the transaction underwent drastic dynamic adjustments during the promotion process: the initial planned fundraising amount was RMB 500 billion , then under the competition of industrial capital from all parties and existing shareholders, the target was raised twice , and the final financing amount directly doubled to the hundred-billion-yuan level .

DeepSeek.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
DeepSeek.titleEn: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
DeepSeek.titleKo: 미국, 연방 기관에 시스템에서 중국 DeepSeek AI 제거 명령
DeepSeek.summary:
The move comes amid intensifying tech competition in AI between the U.S. and China.
The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing services and products developed by Chinese AI startup DeepSeek and remove them from government IT systems over national security concerns tied to the Chinese AI startup’s operations in China, according to the Department of Homeland Security .
The latest order extends the restrictions to federal civilian agencies, covering both new purchases and existing IT systems.

DeepSeek.titleKo: 미국, 중국과의 AI 균열로 인해 정부 기관 시스템에서 DeepSeek 금지
DeepSeek.summary:
The Defense Information Systems Agency moved to block access to DeepSeek models in January 2025, according to reports from Bloomberg.
The agency also warned that using DeepSeek's AI models could result in sensitive U.S. government data being transferred to China, potentially providing intelligence on American citizens and government programs.
The Trump administration has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems, including third-party products and services built using its AI models.

Meta AI.summary:
The company expects capital expenditures between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from the previous $130 billion and $145 billion estimate.
Meta says it would’ve made over $22 billion if it didn’t have to pay a child safety settlement It’s been a busy past few weeks for Meta, which launched its AI agent, Muse , in September.
Susan Li, Meta’s chief financial officer, added during an earnings call that the new class of shares will “expand our funding tools and give us flexibility to invest behind the unprecedented momentum we’re seeing across every part of our business driven by AI.”

Meta AI.title: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
Meta AI.titleEn: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
Meta AI.titleKo: Claude Duet은 Meta Muse 및 OpenAI Dots에 대한 Anthropic의 답변임 · - Engadget
Meta AI.summary:
Duet shares usage with all your other Claude tools, including Code, which sounds like a recipe for the new agent to blow through your rate limits, but Anthropic at least appears to be thinking ahead.
"You can also hand it tasks of all shapes — from simple administrative tasks of scheduling meetings to more complex ones, such as building dashboards with dozens of tools, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps," the company writes, promising Duet will only message you when something requires your attention.
According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.

According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.
summaryLinesKo: Duet은 코드를 포함하여 다른 모든 Claude 도구와 사용법을 공유함 · 이는 새로운 에이전트가 속도 제한을 뛰어넘을 수 있는 방법처럼 들리지만 적어도 Anthropic은 미리 생각하고 있는 것으로 전망
"또한 회의 일정을 잡는 간단한 관리 작업부터 수십 가지 도구를 사용하여 대시보드 구축, 재무 또는 판매 예측 생성, 프로토타이핑, 웹 앱 구축과 같은 보다 복잡한 작업에 이르기까지 모든 형태의 작업을 처리할 수 있음" · 라고 회사에서는 Duet이 사용자의 주의가 필요한 경우에만 메시지를 보낼 것이라고 약속함
Anthropic에 따르면 Duet은 귀하의 비밀번호나 로그인 토큰을 직접 볼 수 없으며 귀하의 건강이나 개인 재정과 관련될 수 있는 정보는 귀하가 Duet에 공유하도록 명시적으로 지시한 경우에만 공개됨

Meta AI.title: Meta's Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta's Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta의 Muse는 40일 만에 미국 다운로드 1,000만 건을 기록함 · 이는 다른 앱 11개만이 달성한 이정표임
Meta AI.summary:
According to new data from market intelligence provider Sensor Tower , Muse has seen 10.9 million downloads since its September debut, 10.2 million of which were in the United States.
Only 11 other apps to date have reached this type of post-launch milestone, said Sensor Tower’s senior insights analyst Kara Lee.
Meta’s AI companion , Muse, is now one of only a dozen mobile apps to have reached 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days on the market.

Flexible Omni Reference: 15 Reference Assets, 10 Keyframes and Video Extension of up to Two Minutes If 2025 marked the breakout year for AI video generation, 2026 has seen the industry boom.
16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kuaishou Technology ("Kuaishou" or the "Company"; HKD Counter Stock Code: 01024 / RMB Counter Stock Code: 81024), a leading content community and social platform, today announced that Kling 4.0, the new-generation video generation model of Kling AI, officially launched on October 15.

2026년 10월 16일(GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 선도적인 콘텐츠 커뮤니티 및 소셜 플랫폼인 Kuaishou Technology("Kuaishou" 또는 "회사", HKD 카운터 재고 코드 · 01024 / RMB 카운터 재고 코드 · 81024)는 Kling AI의 차세대 비디오 생성 모델인 Kling 4.0이 10월 15일 공식 출시되었다고 오늘 발표함
카메라 연출의 경우 Kling 4.0은 최대 30초의 기본 단일 패스 생성을 지원하고 롱 테이크와 연속 스토리텔링을 지원하여 액션, 장면 변화 및 감정 형성이 전체적으로 펼쳐질 수 있도록 함
